name: atwx/silverstripe-gate-api
description: A Silverstripe module adding a JWT authenticated content API to the SilverGate modules. Answers API calls where gate-client is installed, makes them where gate-manager is.

suggest.atwx/silverstripe-gate-client: Enables the site role: answer API calls on a managed site.
suggest.atwx/silverstripe-gate-manager: Enables the manager role: call the API on managed sites.
suggest.lekoala/silverstripe-cms-actions: Adds a Test API button to ManagedSite in the CMS.
